faqs.question: How much does a project cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on your budget and on what you want to build. Start by filling in the project form and sharing your idea. A few lines are enough. We'll reply with a free estimate within one business day, and after a short chat you get a fixed quote in writing, split into milestones, before any work starts.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Not long. Most projects (a website, an online store, an AI tool or a first version of your app) are delivered within a few days. Bigger projects usually take about 5 to 6 days, sometimes a little more or less. We agree the exact timeline with you before we start, and it's written into your proposal.

faqs.question: Do you build mobile and desktop apps?
faqs.answer: Yes. We build Windows, Mac, iPhone and Android apps with installers, licensing, payments, automatic updates and the App Store and Google Play launch. See app development.

faqs.question: Do you work with clients in my country?
faqs.answer: Yes. We work remotely with clients around the world, in English, and schedule calls around your time zone.

faqs.question: Who owns the work when it's finished?
faqs.answer: You do. Once the project is paid, the code, designs and content are yours. Domains, hosting, stores and AI accounts are set up in your name from the start.

faqs.question: Will you sign an NDA?
faqs.answer: Yes. We're happy to sign a mutual NDA before you share confidential details.

faqs.question: How do we stay in touch during a project?
faqs.answer: By email, WhatsApp or video call, whatever suits you, plus short progress updates and a link to the latest working version while we build.

faqs.question: How do payments work?
faqs.answer: Usually a deposit to start and the rest by milestone. We agree on an international payment method that works for you, and the details are in your proposal.

faqs.question: What happens after launch?
faqs.answer: We hand over every login, file and document, fix anything that isn't working as agreed, and offer optional monthly support, improvements and new features.

faqs.question: How quickly will you reply?
faqs.answer: Within one business day. We usually reply with a few questions so we understand what you want to build.

faqs.question: What should I write in my message?
faqs.answer: What you want to achieve, who it is for and any links to your current site or examples you like. A few sentences is enough, and we will ask follow-up questions.

faqs.question: What is Zenra AI Agent?
faqs.answer: A ready-made AI chat agent for your business. It answers customer questions on your website or on a chat link you share, day and night. It saves every lead and passes the chat to your team when a person is needed.

faqs.question: Which website platforms does it work with?
faqs.answer: It works with all of them, including WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, Blogger, Hostinger, GoDaddy, Google Sites and any HTML website. You paste one line of code and the chat bubble appears on every page. The app shows the exact steps for each platform.

faqs.question: What is Zenra AI Viral Clips?
faqs.answer: Zenra AI Viral Clips is a Windows app from Zenra AI that turns long videos into short clips for YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, TikTok and feed posts. The AI picks the strong moments, frames the speaker or the action, adds word-by-word captions and a title, and saves every clip on your PC, up to 4K.

faqs.question: Is Zenra Video Splitter free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Zenra Video Splitter is free, with no watermark, no sign-up and no upload.

faqs.question: Is Zenra Video Downloader free?
faqs.answer: Every new PC gets a 1-day free trial with full access. After that, plans cost $1 for a month, $2 for 6 months, $3 for a year or $10 for lifetime access.
